notes.title: [TheMemory] Now! Official Version Release Updated
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33678060/297e926ed736ffb9c07fc6f4c3f96fe4bff09258.png

The official version has been released.

We have a new team member in Team NPC.
So, a total of four people have become a team.
we send a warm welcome to the new team for taking part in this damn ordeal!


Our team has been up all night since the early access version,
Finally! We're finished now!

We took lessons from everything we lacked in the previous early access, and we did a whole remodeling.

But we still have a lot to do, so we will continue to get your feedback and update it.

Please enjoy our first official work!

we really respect all of you who gave feedback during the early years of Early Access.

We will continue to receive feedback, so please reprimand it. ;)

notes.title: Notify "The Memory" official release!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33678060/feaa2919f7e82e8dc95a544739ea4947e1f9b3eb.png

Finally, The Memory is about to be officially launched.
Many things have happened so far, so the official launch was later than expected.

we make up for the game fun and the lack of a story
We actively reflected players feedback,
and tried hard to express that in the game.

Added to according to feedbacks

-A different progression from Early Access.

-Save&Load function

-Achievement

-Add Tutorial

-More risk factors

-Adjust difficulty balance

-a lot of small bugs fixed


Experience the rest in the game!
currently, We are working at the last stage.
It will be released as soon as the update is made available.

Thank you for your support.
